question: The 147.5 m switch parts of squareT_platform_squareT_switch (a 0.07 x 0.41 x 0.96 m face, bottom 0.27 m, lateral -0.29 m; EXPERIMENTS 1f) lie beyond the verified height reference and pass the far-field rule (>= far_min_height 0.6 m tall, <= 3 m long, bottom <= 1.0 m) like a person. Fewer STOP episodes from them without losing any set F straight object or range.

preregistered.target: Switch-part STOP episodes in squareT_platform_squareT_switch: STOP episodes (runs of consecutive frames with obstacle true) in which any frame has a confirmed gauge detection at 140-155 m, counted by the attached definition on the per-frame JSONL. Shipped defaults: 4 episodes (frames 500-501, 580, 640-642, 692-708), 19 STOP frames with such a detection. The target improves when the episode count is < 4.
preregistered.ship_rule: A candidate is shippable when (1) python scripts/regression_gate.py --cache /data/cache --jobs 1 --set cluster.far_min_height=<v> --baseline docs/evidence/results/regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_column.json exits 0 (no gated row worse, none missing; the six recordings, set O, the ride and set F straight), (2) the target improves as defined, and (3) every safety condition holds. Among shippable candidates: the one with the fewest switch-part STOP episodes; a tie goes to the lower threshold (the least intrusive). If none is shippable: far_min_height stays 0.6 and the numbers are recorded.
safety_conditions: doubleT_obstacle: labelled hits per label (person_crossing, object_on_rail, object_on_rail_from_frame_75) identical or better; first alarm frame identical or earlier; fp events not higher
set O: every inside object's STOP frames not fewer and first STOP not at a shorter distance; outside false STOP frames, background alarm frames and track ids not higher

set F straight, every kind (person, box1.0, box0.5, trolley, cable): detected sequences not fewer; median first confirmation not shorter (the person's ~151 m headline must not drop); false detections not higher
no new false alarm: alarm events and STOP episodes not higher in each of the five obstacle-free recordings and in the ride
preregistered.procedure: Cheaper stages first, each only for a candidate that survived the previous one: (1) squareT_platform_squareT_switch alone (scripts/eval_real.py --bags squareT_platform_squareT_switch --set ...): the target; (2) set F straight alone (scripts/far_range_eval.py with the gate's parameters and the effective config): the hard safety condition; (3) the full gate with the ride. A candidate that fails a stage is recorded with the stage's numbers and not run further. Native path, --jobs 1, receive stamps, the 4-vCPU dev VM.

candidate.rule: cluster.far_axis_both_sides becomes a mode: 0 = off (today, byte for byte), 1 = the form of addendum 1 as measured (true reads as 1), 2 = the new form. Mode 2: (i) only on frames whose axis does not get today's straight bonus (|curvature| < 1e-4, wall rms < 0.2 m and both sides agreeing) and has two fitted boundaries; there the far limit is the shorter side's last bin + track.axis_valid_margin (no bonus); on straight frames, and with one boundary or none, no limit; (ii) applied after the clustering as a demotion of would-be obstacles only: a corridor cluster (kind '') that is a gauge obstacle by every other rule and lies beyond max(height reference, far limit) becomes advisory (reason beyond_axis); every other cluster keeps its reason, so a column stays a column hit; (iii) the verified-clear range ends at max(height reference, far limit) on those frames. Inside the height reference nothing changes.

choice.text: No candidate is shippable. far_min_height 0.8 / 0.9 / 1.0 and far_axis_both_sides 1 fail the hard safety condition on set F straight; far_axis_both_sides 2 passes the gate (5 gated rows better) and set F straight (identical) but fails its pre-registered gentle-curve condition (person 124.1 -> 122.2 m). cluster.far_axis_both_sides stays 0 (off; output byte-identical to be39362, checked frame by frame on squareT_platform_squareT_switch and by the unchanged tests); far_min_height stays 0.6.
